scenarios.name: Normal planning conditions
scenarios.frozen_rule: Normal capacities, costs, transit, recipes, approvals and terminal demand.

scenarios.name: Semiconductor boundary-source outage
scenarios.frozen_rule: Critical Tier 4 silicon source operates at 30% in P03-P05, 60% in P06 and recovers in P07.

scenarios.name: Asia-Europe logistics disruption
scenarios.frozen_rule: Affected lanes use transit multiplier 1.75, freight multiplier 1.40 and capacity multiplier 0.75 in P02-P07; air remains available.

scenarios.name: Tier 1 node disruption
scenarios.frozen_rule: Selected Tier 1 node is unavailable in P04, operates at 50% in P05 and recovers in P06.

scenarios.name: Regional multi-tier capacity event
scenarios.frozen_rule: Selected Tier 2-Tier 4 nodes in one region receive a calibrated 20-40% capacity reduction.

scenarios.name: Combined severe disruption and demand uplift
scenarios.frozen_rule: SCN-01 and SCN-02 overlap with a calibrated 10-15% uplift in selected terminal demand.

reference_environment.language: Candidate-selected professional runtime; Python 3.12 is used only by the public data-validation utility
reference_environment.data_handling: Typed schema validation, complete dataset-version selection and explicit dimensional checks
reference_environment.algebraic_modelling: Explicit MILP or MINLP in a suitable candidate-selected algebraic modelling library
reference_environment.recursive_solver: Candidate-selected workflow; integer feasibility and any departures from recursive accounting must be disclosed and validated
reference_environment.reference_benchmark: A validated BASE incumbent under the recursive formulation is supplied as calibration evidence; it is not a model input or an optimality target
reference_environment.testing: Candidate-selected automated testing with deterministic physical, value, cost-ledger and adversarial evidence

controlled_open_decisions: exact entity counts within approved ranges
propagated bounds, epsilon and validation safety margins
reference recursive solver, licence and fallback route
exact ranged scenario coefficients and targets
output precision, display rounding and empty-case behaviour
